pages.text: Hunger and health are separate stored nutrients, not FE. Matching modules collect them, processors transfer or produce them, and restoration uses the player’s current need and the module’s available contents.$p$(l)Sources and routes$()$pAmethyst leaves — Hunger nutrient; matching piping/logs reach a Hunger Processor.$pTanzanite leaves — Health nutrient; matching piping/logs reach a Health Processor.$pHunger Processor — Can accept food nutrition and matching module contents.$pHealth Processor — Uses its recipe-defined health sources and matching module contents.$pNutrition Module — Carries both nutrient types and can restore automatically while carried/installed.$pNutrition-network traversal is bounded and checks loaded chunks. The shipped visit limit is 512 positions; this is a safety boundary, not a chunk loader. A disconnected tree or denied leaf harvest can stop collection without changing the processor inventory.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/hunger_processor)Hunger Processor$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/health_processor)Health Processor$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/stone_assimilator)Stone Assimilator$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/nutrition_module)Nutrition Module$()
